sources.fact: LBBD Regulation 19 Cabinet HTML lists XD - Hepworth Southwold Drive as a site-allocation attachment.
Cabinet approval relates to publication of the submission Local Plan and is not an individual XD planning permission.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024.
The adopted Local Plan is the starting point for decision-making, not an automatic site consent.
The Local Plan is part of the Development Plan used to assess applications.
Be First provides statutory planning application services for LBBD.
LBBD states Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; allocation identity is not permission.
Accurate land/property identification for a land-charge search requires a site location plan.
Local Land Charges concern restrictions/legal obligations and are distinct from planning allocation and HMLR title extent.
Building-control processes are separate from the planning-permission status of XD.
LBBD separates planning, building control and land-charge functions; none are conflated for promotion.
No exact current XD residential application/decision was verified from accessible official HTML this wave.
